items.title: Cloudflare Adds Optional OAuth Scopes, Letting Developers Mark What Users May Decline
items.blurb: Cloudflare has added optional OAuth scopes, letting client owners mark which permissions users may deselect at consent. The company names MCP servers as the motivating case, since agents request the union of everything they might do.

items.title: I turned my security cameras into an automatic bird identification system
items.blurb: I turned three security cameras into an automatic bird identification system using BirdNet-Go. Now my wife and I can track every bird species that visits our yard in real-time.

items.title: OpenClaw 2.0 Releases with Simplified Setup and Collaborative Agents
items.blurb: OpenClaw has released OpenClaw 2.0, a major update to the open-source personal AI agent that changes its installation process, browser interface, memory, skills, automations, plugins, security, and collaboration features.
